source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
reference: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 Okthoba 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.
hypothesis: Ukumkani uLouis XVI, uNkosikazi Marie Antoinette, abantwana babo ababini (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engama-11 ubudala kunye noLouis-Charles oneminyaka engama-4 ubudala) kunye nomninawa wakhe, uMadame Elizabeth, ngo-Okthobha 6, 1789 babanjwa bephuma eVersailles baya eParis ngabasemagunyeni beentengiso.

source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
reference: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.
hypothesis: Emkhunjini, babuyela eParis bezungeza abantu abaningi begijima, beshayela izinsolo ngokumelene noKumkani noNkosazana.

source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
reference: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.
hypothesis: Umfanekiso wezabantu wawenza ukuba iNkosi neNkosazana zivulekele ngokukhululekileyo emaweni yazo.

source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
reference: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.
hypothesis: Ngomzuzu omnye umthetho weqembu waveza intloko yomgcini-sango obulewe eVersailles phambi kwenkosikazi enesithukuthezi.

source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
reference: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.
hypothesis: Imiphumela yomthetho wokubusa kwaseMelika ekuhlaselweni kwabo ePhilippines yatholwa yizakhamuzi zabo.

source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
reference: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.
hypothesis: Bayo bekhokhwa ukukhokhela imali yentela kwi-US regime yasekoloni ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezingxenye ezinkulu zezindleko kanye nezingxenye zokubuyisela imali yezikweletu eziyiswe phansi ngegama lomphakathi wasePhilippines nge-Wall Street banking houses.

source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
reference: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.
hypothesis: Ngokuqinisekile, i-superprofits etholakala ekusebenziseni kwexesha elide yabantu baseFilipino izoba yizinzuzo eziphambili ze-U.S. imperialism.

source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
reference: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.
hypothesis: Ukuqonda ama-Templars kumele uqonde isimo esenza ukuba i-oda yenziwe.

source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
reference: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).
hypothesis: Ubudala lapho kwenzeka lezi zinto luyaziwa ngokuthi yi-Middle Ages ephakeme, isikhathi esidume kakhulu emlandweni waseYurophu ekhulwini le-11, le-12, ne-13 (AD 1000–1300).

source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
reference: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.
hypothesis: Imi Ephakathi Ephakeme yalandelwa yiminyaka Ephakathi Ekuqaleni futhi yalandelwa yiminyaka Ephakathi Ekhulayo, okuyiyo ngokuvamile iphela ngo-1500.

source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
reference: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
hypothesis: Ukucabanga kweteknoloji kuyinkolelo enkulu yokuthi amasiko ethu asekelwe kakhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kusukela ekucindezelweni kweteknoloji noma isimiso sokuthi inzuzo yabantu ibhekene neziqondiso zezimiso zezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
reference: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "zinethonya" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.
hypothesis: Iningi lezizindlo ze-technological determinism zitholakala zinamaqiniso amabili: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kweteknoloji kuyahambisana nomgwaqo okungaphezu kwamakhono noma izimo zomphakathi, futhi ukuthi iteknoloji kuyabonakala "imiphumela" emiphakathini enjalo, engaphansi kwemvelo yomphakathi.

source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
reference: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.
hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, umuntu angasho ukuthi imoto kumele ibe yisizathu sokuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Nokho, imigwaqo exhumanisa izwe lonke ayizuzisi ngokomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje kuphela, ngakho izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ziyenziwa ukunciphisa inani lokuba nemoto.
hypothesis: Kodwa, umzila wendlela yomhlaba wonke awunamandla kwezomnotho ngenxa yezimoto ezincane, ngakho amasu amasha asetshenziswa ukuze kuncishiswe izindleko zokuthenga imoto.

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Ukuba nezimoto kwabantu abaningi nakho kuholela ezigamekweni eziphakeme zezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekusungulweni kwezindlela ezintsha kwezempilo zokulungisa imizimba elimele.
hypothesis: Umfundisi wokuphila kwezimoto kanye nezingozi ezingaba khona emgwaqeni, okuholela ekudaleni amasu amatsha emitholampilo yokulungisa amaphupho abonakalayo.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Ezothando zinomthelela omkhulu ezinkolelweni zokuziphatha zamasiko, okuthathelwa kubabhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, kanye noSchlegel.
hypothesis: Ukukhathazeka kwentando yesintu kwakukhona okuningi okubalulekile kwamakhomishini abafundi abafana neGoethe, Fichte, neSchlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Esizindeni seRomanticism, indawo ibumba abantu ngabanye, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imikhuba nesiko ehlobene naleyo ndawo yavela, futhi lena, ivumelana nendawo yomphakathi, yayingcono kunemithetho emiswe ngokunganaki.
hypothesis: Kwi-imeko ye-Romanticism, i-geography yabenza abantu, kwaye kwakusoloko kubonakala ukuba iinkcubeko kunye neentlanga ezinxulumene nale ndawo zenzekile, kwaye ezi, zikwabelana ngokuhambelana nendawo yomphakathi, zaba ngcono kunalawo mithetho esenziwe ngokweqile.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Ngendlela iParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yezwe lamanje, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yezikhonzi zaseYurophu.
hypothesis: Ngendlela eParis yaziwa njengomkhakha wefashoni wezwe lamuhla, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengomkhakha wefashoni weYurophu yasefulethini.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yalapho kwaqala khona izinto zikanokusho cishe ngo-400 A.D. futhi yahlala cishe kwaze kaba u-1100 A.D.
hypothesis: Ukuthandwa kwayo kwaba yindawo yezinto eziphakeme kwaqala ngo-400 AD kwaye kwahlala de kube ngu-1100 AD.

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Isimo sayo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leminyaka leshumi nambili ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yokuthi Abalweli Benkolo babebuye bephethe izipho ezinjengosilika nezinongo ezaziyigugu kunalezo imakethe yaseByzantium eyayinazo.
hypothesis: Ukususwa kwesimo sayo kwenzeka ngenkathi yezi-12th century, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokuthi ama-Crusaders abuyele eziphambili zabo, eza nezipho ezifana ne-silks ne-spices ezazingabalelwa kakhulu kunalezo ezitholakala emakethe ye-Byzantine.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Kwakungalesi sikhathi lapho ukudluliselwa kwesiqu seNhlokodolobha yeMfashini kusuka eKhonstantinopheli kuya ePherisi kwenziwa.
hypothesis: Kwakukhona ngesikhathi ukudluliselwa kwesihloko seFashion Capital kusuka eConstantinople eParis.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Isitayela sobuGothiki sakhula ngenkathi ephakathi kwamakhulu weminyaka wama-10 -11 nekhulu leminyaka lama-14.
hypothesis: Ukubukeka kweGothic kwavela phakathi kwekhulu le-10th - le-11th kanye nekhulu le-14th.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Ekuqaleni ukwembatha kwakuthonywe kakhulu isiko laseByzantium empumalanga.
hypothesis: Ngasekuqaleni, ingubo yayisithonya kakhulu isiko le-Byzantine esempumalanga.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Noma kunjalo, ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izitayela zasentshonalanga zingasalela emuva ngeminyaka ewu-25 ukuya kwengu-30.
hypothesis: Kodwa ngenxa yeziteshi zokuxhumana ezisindayo, amafomu eNtshonalanga angahambisani neminyaka engu-25 kuya kwengu-30.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Ngasekupheleni kweNkathi Ephakathi intshonalanga Yurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yentuthuko enkulu kakhulu yaleso sikhathi ngenxa yabalweli benkolo abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukubopha izimpahla zokugqoka.
hypothesis: Emva kwesiphelo seMiddle Ages, eYurophu yasentshonalanga yaqala ukuthuthukiswa kwesitayela. Enye yezinto ezinkulu zokuthuthukiswa wawuyisikhathi eside abantu basebenzisa amabhotshisi ukuze bafake izingubo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezinkampani zokuhamba.

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa ukulima okwenzelwa ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomlimi kanye nomdeni wakhe kuphela.
hypothesis: Ukulima okuzuzisa yilokho okwenziwa ukuze kudlulwe ukudla okwanele ukuze kuhlangatshezwane neemfuno zomlimi nomndeni wakhe.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa indlela elula, ngovamile okususelwe ezintweni eziphilayo, kusetshenziswa imbewu egciniwe yasendaweni enezici ezingokwemvelo kuhlanganiswe nokushintshashintsha izilimo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula zokwenza umkhiqizo ube mningi.
hypothesis: Ukulima okuzimele kuyindlela elula, ngokuvamile eluhlaza, esebenzisa imbewu eyasindiswa yezwekazi elithile kanye ne-crop rotation noma amanye amasu ahlukahlukene okwandisa umkhiqizo.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.
hypothesis: Ngokomlando, abalimi abaningi babekade behileleke emisebenzini yokulima okwanele, futhi lokhu kuseqhubeka emazweni amaningi asakhasayo.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.
hypothesis: Imizila yezakhiwo zomphakathi yahlanganisa abantu abanomdla ofanayo abazizwa bengahlali yizingxenye zomphakathi futhi babavumela ukuthi baphathelele isimo sobuntu.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
hypothesis: Imiphakathi engaphansi ingaba yizinto eziyingqayizivele ngenxa yobudala, ubuzwe, isigaba, indawo, noma ubulili bomalungu.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
hypothesis: Imigomo ehlukanisa isiko esincane njengeyodwa ingaba yilimi, amahlelo, ukukholwa, ukuphikisana, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zinto.

source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.
hypothesis: Amalungu esizwe esincane ngokuvamile abonisa ubulungu babo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esithile nesimemelela, okubandakanya imfashini, imizamo, ne-argot.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.
hypothesis: Enye yezindlela ezivamile ezisetshenziselwa ukuveza ukubaluleka kokuxhumana yizindaba ezithile zabantwana abathintekayo, ngenxa yokungahambisani, inhlekelele, noma ukudlwengulwa, abazange baxhumane nabantu abadala ngenkathi bekhula.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
hypothesis: Abantwana abanjalo banegama elithi "feral" noma elingahleliwe. Abanye abantwana abahleliwe bangababonwa abantu (ngokuvamile abazali babo); kwesinye isikhathi lokhu ukuboshwa kwabantwana kwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo babekholelwa ukuthi umntwana wayo impilo enzima yobuchopho noma emzimbeni.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.
hypothesis: Amantombazane asezingeni eliphansi angase afikeleleke ekubeni abuswa kakhulu noma baphathwe ngezinye izimo ezinzima zokuhlukunyezwa kwabantwana ngaphambi kokuba baphumelele noma baphumelele.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.
hypothesis: Abanye bathi babekhwezelwa yizilwane; abanye bathi babehlala emthunzini yezilwane.

source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
reference: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
hypothesis: Ukuba umntwana wafundiswa ngokupheleleyo yizilwanyana ezingekho phantsi kwezilwanyana, umntwana wezilwanyana uza kubonisa imisebenzi (ngaphakathi kwemida) enjengezilwanyana zokukhathalela, njengokukhathazeka okanye ukungahloniphi kwabantu.

source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
reference: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.
hypothesis: Ngelinye icala, ukuqeqeshwa okusekelwe kwiprojekthi kufanele kube lula futhi kube mnandi, kodwa ukuqeqeshwa okusekelwe kwisakhiwo kuyadlula leyo.

source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
reference: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
hypothesis: Ukukhanyisa akuyona indlela yokufunda, kodwa isekela abantu abasebenzisa amanye amaphrojekthi amasha, njengekusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.

source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
reference: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.
hypothesis: Imibhobho ingaba zombili virtual ne real, okusho umfundisi yimiba yomsebenzi kodwa ne little paperclip man e Microsoft Office.

source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
reference: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.
hypothesis: Amasethi we-Virtual asetshenziswa ngaphakathi kwesofthiwe futhi abekwe ukuze babuze imibuzo, baphakamise, futhi bahlaziye izinqubo ezingaba nzima kakhulu ukuzenza yedwa.

source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
reference: Izingane zigcinwa emakhaya anakekela abantwana ngezizathu eziningi njengokukhishwa inyumbazane, ukuhlukunyezwa kanye nokuphamba.
hypothesis: Amantombazane asetshenziswa kwizindlu zokuthuthukiswa ngenxa yezizathu eziningi ezahlukene ezivela ekusweleni, ukudlwengulwa, nokukhokhwa.

source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
reference: Kayikho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engalungile, engenalo uthando, engenankathalo kanye nemfundo, kodwa kuyenzeka.
hypothesis: Akukho mntwana okufanele ahlale endaweni engenazithandayo, eningabazithandayo, eningabafundayo, kepha abaningi bayenza.

source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
reference: Sikholelwa ukuthi Uhlelo Lokutholwa Kwezingane luzoba yindawo yokuphepha yalezi zingane.
hypothesis: Thina siyabona ukuthi uhlelo lwe Foster Care luyindawo yokuphepha yaba yinina.

source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
reference: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.
hypothesis: Inkqubo yethu yokukhusela abantwana ibekwe ukuba ibonelele ngezindlu eziyimfihlo, abazali abathandayo, imfundo esisigxina, kunye nonyango oluthembekileyo.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.
hypothesis: Ukukhuthazwa kwemfundo kumele unikeze zonke izidingo ezingafuneki kwendlu abaziswa kuyo.

source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
reference: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.
hypothesis: Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zombili zokuxhumana okuningi neziphakathi.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.
hypothesis: Imiphumela ehlukahlukene ye-Inthanethi yenza amagama amaningi mayelana ne-uses and gratifications approach.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusbenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).
hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" ne "ukuxhumana" kubhekwa njengokufuna okubalulekile kwe-intanethi (James et al., 1995).

source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
reference: "Ukuhlanganyela komuntu siqu" kanye "nobudlelwane obuqhubekayo" kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zesisusa ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.
hypothesis: Ukutholakala kwabantu abathintekayo kanye nokusekelwa kwesibopho sabantu abathintekayo kwakubonakala njengomthetho wokuziphendulela kwezinsizakalo ze-intanethi, njengoba kuboniswa ngu-Eighmey and McCord (1998).

source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
reference: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.
hypothesis: Ukusetshenziswa kwevidiyo yokurekhoda kuye kwaholela ekutholeni imicabango emikhulu ekucabangeni kwamagama amancane, ukudweba ubuso obude obusendaweni ephawulekayo.

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.
hypothesis: Ngokukhethekile, kuthiwa kungenzeka ukuthi uqaphele ukuthi umuntu ulalela ngokucophelela ngokucabanga ngokucacile ngokucabanga ngokucacile.

source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
reference: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, uphawule ukuthi abantu okunzima ngabo ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.
hypothesis: U-Oliver Sacks, esebenzisana naye ephakamileyo kwi-Paper ye-Presideni, wabonisa indlela abantu abangenakuthola ukuthi bayakwazi ukuqonda ukuthetha ngenxa yezifo zengqondo, kodwa bayakwazi ukuqonda ukuthembeka ngokucacileyo.

source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
reference: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha yabantu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.
hypothesis: Ukuthi nokuba abantu bangakwazi ukucabanga ngezimo zomuntu, kubonakala ukuthi lezi zici zikwaziwa futhi zezilwane ezifuywayo ezifana nezinganekwane.

source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
reference: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhluka: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.
hypothesis: Ucwaningo lwesikhathi sokuqala kwesigidi luye lwabonisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi amabili okuhlukahluka kwenzalo: amanzi afihliwe neyabonakala.

source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
reference: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.
hypothesis: Ukushintshwa kwesigaba esithile se-genetic variation kuyasiza ekuthuthukiseni kwezinto eziphilayo, kanti ukukhethwa kwezinto eziphilayo kuyasusa ukushintshwa kwesigaba esithile se-genetic variation.

source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
reference: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
hypothesis: Ukwehlukaniswa nokubuyiswa kwemvelo kudlulela phakathi kwamabhodlela amabili ngezizukulwane zonke.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.
hypothesis: Kwi savanna, kunzima kwi primate enomzimba womuntu ukuthi ugcine izidingo zayo ze-amino acid ezitholakala kwezitshalo.

source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
reference: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, kanye nokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaziphathelani kuyahluleka ukubhekana nezinkinga eziphakeme: ukukhula okungaphumeleli, ukudla okungaphumeleli, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.

source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
reference: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.
hypothesis: Imvelo epholileyo yezityalo zingaba iiprotheni ezingafumanekiyo kwiilayini neziqhamo, kodwa zinomdla kwiiprimates ezifana nathi ukuba zityhilelwe.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.
hypothesis: Ngokuphambene, izakhiwo zezilwane (izintaba, izintaba, amaqanda) awazange zilungiswe kalula, kodwa zinikeza amaprotheni aphezulu anezakhiwo ze-amino acid zonke ezidingekayo.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumelwe simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.
hypothesis: Ngaphandle kokucabanga, akufanele sikhathazeke uma thina abazali bethu bahlulele "inhlalakahle yezinto" zabo ngendlela efanayo neyamachibi ase-savanna namuhla.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).
hypothesis: Ukuvalelwa kwesikhashana kuyindlela yokuzivalela phakathi kwesikhathi sakho sokulala futhi uqale phansi kwakhona emva kwemizuzu engu-10 kuya kwengu-60.

source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
reference: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto zingatholakala kalula ngokusebenzisa i-alarm clock elithambileyo ukuze uthole wena ukuze ube nomqondo wokungena ngaphandle kokuphuma ngokuphelele.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.
hypothesis: Uma uzitholela uzibuyisele isikhathi esikude, kungaba kuhle ukuthi usethe kwesinye isikhathi esikude, ukuze uthole ukuphumula emakhaya ukuze ushintshe isikhathi.

source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
reference: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.
hypothesis: Ozakwethu, kunezinye izinketho ze-biorhythm-based ezibandakanya ukuphuza amanzi amaningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-diuretic) ngaphambi kokulala, okuholela ekutheni uphumelele ekuseni.

source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
reference: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.
hypothesis: Inani lomoya wangaphakathi umuntu aneliseke luhambisana ngokuphambene nezinani zomzimba nomoya wakhe zokucindezeleka.

source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
reference: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.
hypothesis: Ukunciphisa ukucindezeleka, kunikeza amandla okuphila okuhle. Wonke umuntu unamandla okuthola ukuthula okuphelele nokuhlale kahle.

source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
reference: Wonke umuntu angaphumelela. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.
hypothesis: Bonke bangenzi ukuqonda. Into kuphela esibambelela kulokho yimibuthano yethu nokungahambisani.

source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
reference: UbuBhuda base-Tibet busekelwe ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.
hypothesis: Umbundu waseTibet Buddhist wasekelwa ngemfundiso zikaBuddha, kodwa wadlula ngendlela yeMahayana yothando nezingxenye eziningi zamaYoga aseNdiya.

source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
reference: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.
hypothesis: Ngokomqondo, i-Tibetan Buddhism ilula kakhulu. Iqukethe i-Kundalini Yoga, imilingo, kanye nomgwaqo wokuthanda konke.

source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
reference: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.
hypothesis: Ngokusebenzisa i-Kundalini Yoga, amandla we-Kundalini (amandla okuhlakaniphile) awuzwa ngokusebenzisa imiphetho ye-Yoga, imisebenzi yokuphefumula, amazwi amanga, kanye ne-visualizations.

source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
reference: Isikhungo sokuzindla kwase-Tibet iYoga yesiThixo. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.
hypothesis: Umkhakha wokucula wamaTibet yiDeity Yoga. Ngokubonakala kwezithombe zezithombe ezahlukene, amachibi amanzi ahlaziywa, amachibi e-chakras aqaliswa futhi ukuqonda okuphakeme kudalwa.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.
hypothesis: Jalimane yayiyindawo ethandwayo yomzabalazo weMpi Yezwe 2, okuholela ekubambeni kwamaSoviet Union ne-USA. Ngasekupheleni kwempi, ukwehlukana kwesistimu, inqubo ne-culture kwaholela ekubeni amazwe ahluke.

source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
reference: Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yempi, ababeyimifela ndawonye empini manje sebeyizitha futhi sebeqalise Impi Ebandayo.
hypothesis: Ngeminyaka emibili ekupheleni kwempi, abalingani abadala babekho njengezitha futhi uMfazwe Opholileyo waqala.

source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
reference: Kwakufanele ihlale iminyaka engu-40 elandelayo futhi kulwe kuyo ngokoqobo, amabutho abambele, ezinkundleni zempi kusukela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba kanye nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.
hypothesis: Kwakukhona ukulwa okuzophela iminyaka engamashumi amane, futhi kuzophakanyiswa yizingane zomuntu, amabutho abaphikisanayo, emhlabeni wase-Afrika nase-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba, nakwamanye amazwe amaningi.

source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
reference: NgoSepthemba 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.
hypothesis: Ngomhla ka-September 17, 1939, isibhakabhaka somkhosi wasePoland sasisele siyaphukile, futhi ithemba elilodwa kuphela lalokho ukuba sihambisane futhi siyakhele kabusha emhlabeni waseRomania.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka kuyiSoviet's Union Red Army engena akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.
hypothesis: Kodwa lezi zinqumo zaba yize ngobusuku obuhle, lapho abantu abangaphezu kuka-800,000 bekhonza eRed Army yaseSoviet Union bafike bese beqala iBelarussian neUkraine Fronts ngokungenelela kwemikhawulo yasePoland, okuphazamisekile kwiRiga Peace Treaty, iSoviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, nezinye izivumelwano zomhlaba wonke, zombili zomuntu nabazizwa.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.
hypothesis: Ukusebenzisa izikebhe ukuze uthumele izimpahla kuyinto enenzuzo kakhulu yokuhamba ngezinto eziningi kanye nezimpahla emhlabeni wonke.

source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
reference: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.
hypothesis: Inkolelo yamasosha yisiphi esizweni ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi izizwe zakho zinokuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla zakho, ngenkathi kuthintwe amandla okuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla zomuntu wesibili.

source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
reference: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.
hypothesis: Enye yezizathu ezinkulu zokubaluleka kwalezi zinsuku zamuva kwaba iNorth Atlantic Campaign of WWII. Ama-Amerikans ayefuna ukuthutha amadoda nezinto zokusebenza olwandle ukuze asize eBrithani.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.
hypothesis: Ngelo xesha, ulwandle lweJalimane, usebenzisa i-U-boats, lalwa kakhulu ukuyeka loo msebenzi.

source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
reference: Ukube amaZwe Ayelwa neJalimane ayehlulekile, iJalimane cishe belizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.
hypothesis: Uma i-Allies ayiphumelelanga, iGermany cishe ingaba yingxenye ye-Britain njengoba yenze ne-Europe yonke.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.
hypothesis: Imbuzi zibonakala zabaqalwa zizigidi eziyikhulu nanye kweminyaka eyadlulayo eZagros Mountains of Iran.

source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
reference: Amasiko nezizwana zamandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyaka, kanye nesikhumba.
hypothesis: Imbali yezakhiwo zasendulo nezintlanga ziqale ukuzigcina ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kuzo amanzi, izinwele, inyama, nezinwele.

source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
reference: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lesi sibonelo sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.

source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
reference: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
hypothesis: Imizila yamawele yawudalwa eNgilandi kusukela ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-16.

source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
reference: Nakuba ama-wagonway bewenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma i-wagonways yayiqukethe amapulangwe amabili anezintambo zomthunzi, kwakukhona amahhashi abathwala okwakha amandla okusheshisa futhi abathwala iziqu eziphakeme kunalezo zomgwaqo wekhulu le-18.

source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
reference: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.
hypothesis: Amacandelo okuhambisa amabanga aqaliswe ngokuhleliwe ekuqaleni ukuze ahlale endaweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kunqunywe ukuthi amabanga angcono kakhulu uma enezindonga zensimbi phezulu.

source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
reference: Lokhu kwaba inqubo evamile, kodwa insimbi yayihlikihla amasondo okhuni wezinqola.

hypothesis: Abazalwane babo, i-Australopithecus, ababehamba ngobunye njengesiko.

source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.

hypothesis: Abakwa-Arabs bafikile ne-Islam ezweni, futhi kwathatha indawo enkulu e-Comoros ne-Mayotte.

source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
reference: Ithonya laseYurophu kanye nobukoloni kwaqala ngekhulu leminyaka lama-15, njengoba inhloli yomPutukezi u-Vasco da Gama ithola Indlela yaseKapa kusuka eYurophu ukuya eNdiya.
hypothesis: Ukudluliselwa kwamandla aseYurophu nokuhlalisana kwasekwa ngo-15th century, lapho uVasco da Gama, umhloli wePortuguese, wafumana iCape Route evela eYurophu aye eNdiya.

source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Endaweni esenyakatho ikhawuliswe yiSahel, futhi eningizimu kanye nasentshonalanga uLwandlekazi i-Atlantic.
hypothesis: Emazantsi nasentshonalanga, le ndawo igcwele iSahel, kanti elaseNtshonalanga igcwele uLwandle lweAtlantic.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Abesifazane: Kutuswa ukuthi noma ngabe yiziphi izivakashi zesifazane zithi zishadile, kungakhathalekile ukuthi zishadile yini noma azishadile.
hypothesis: Abafazi: Kunconywa ukuba abafazi abahamba baye bathi bangaboshwa, kungakhathaleki ukuthi bangobani ngempela.

source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
reference: Kuyasiza nokufaka indandatho (kodwa hayi ebukeka ibiza.
hypothesis: Kuyasiza ukuba ube ne-ring (ngaphandle kokuba ibukeke kakhulu).

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Abesifazane kumelwe baqaphele ukuthi ukungafani kwamasiko kungaholela kulokho abangacabanga ukuthi ukuhlushwa futhi akukhona okungavamile ukulandelwa, ukubanjwa ngengalo, njll.
hypothesis: Amakhosikazi kufanele bazi ukuthi ukwahlukana kwamasiko kungabangela ukuthi baphathwe ngendlela abayibona ngayo yona, futhi akunzima ukuthi bafundwe, baphathe noma bahlupheke.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Qina lapho wenqaba amadoda, futhi ungesabi ukuzimela (umehluko wamasiko noma cha, awenzi kube okulungile!).
hypothesis: Ungenelele ekubeni uthintele amadoda, ungakhathazeki ukuma endaweni yakho (ngaphandle kwemigomo yesintu noma cha, akuyona into evumelekile!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Idolobha lanamuhla laseCasablanca lasungulwa abadobi baseBerber ngekhulu lama-10 leminyaka BCE, futhi belisetshenziswa abantu baseFenike, eRoma, kanye namaMerenid njengetheku elisendaweni ekahle elibizwa nge-Anfa.
hypothesis: Imizi yesimanje yeCasablanca yasungulwa ngabakwaBerber abasebenzi bemikhumbi emuva kwekhulu le-10 BCE, futhi yasetshenziswa yiziphuthisane, amaRoma, kanye neMerenids njenge-Anfa esiteshini esibalulekile.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: AmaPutukezi alichitha futhi alakha kabusha ngaphansi kwegama leCAsa Branca, ukuze nje aliyeke dengwane ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngo-1755.
hypothesis: Abantu basePortugal babulala lona futhi balakheka ngokuthi Casa Branca, bese kubaqhuba lapho emva kwentwasahlobo yase1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Inkosi yaseMorocco yakha kabusha leli dolobha njengeDaru l-Badya futhi lanikezwa igama lokuthi iCasablanca ngabathengisi baseSpeyini abamisa izindawo zokuhweba lapho.
hypothesis: ISultan yaseMorocco wakha idolobha laseDar l-Badya futhi lathola igama laseCasablanca ngabathengisi baseSpanish abasebenzisana khona.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: ICasablanca enye yezindawo ezingathakazelisi kakhulu yokuthenga kuyo eMorocco yonke.
hypothesis: Casablanca ingenye izindawo ezincane ezithakazelisayo zokuthenga kuzo zonke eMorocco.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Eduze neMedina endala kulula ukuthola izindawo ezidayisa izinto ezingokwesiko zase-Morocco, njenge-tagines, izinto zobumba, izinto zesikhumba, amapayipi okubhema, kanye neminikilishwana eminingi yokuhlobisa, kodwa konke okwezivakashi.
hypothesis: Emhlabeni wonke waseMedina endala, kulula ukuthola izindawo ezithengisa izinto zendabuko Morocco, njenge-tagines, i-pottery, izinto zesikhumba, i-hookahs, kanye ne-geegaws yonke, kodwa yonke le nto yenzelwe abathengi.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: IGoma yidolobha laseDemocratic Republic of Congo elise mpumalanga eduzane naseRwanda eliheha izivakashi.
hypothesis: Goma is idolobha lomtholampilo lwezokuvakasha laseDemocratic Republic of Congo empumalanga ephakathi eduze neRwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Ngo-2002 iGoma yabhujiswa udaka olushisayo oluvela kuyintabamlilo iNyirogongo eyagqiba eminingi yemigwaqo yasedolobheni, ikakhulukazi maphakathi nedolobha.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-2002 iGoma yadliwa yilawa elivela eNyiragongo volcano elibekwe emigwaqeni eminingi yomuzi, ikakhulukazi emaphakathi.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Nakuba iGoma iphephile ngokwezinga elithile, noma ikuphi ukuvakasha ngaphandle kweGoma kumelwe kucwaningwe ukuze uzwisise isimo sokulwa okusesifundazweni saseNyakatho Kivu.
hypothesis: Ngelinye ixesha, Goma ilungile, kodwa naziphi na iindwendwe ngaphandle kweGoma kufuneka zifundwe ukuze zifunde malunga neendawo zokulwa eziphakathi kweNorth Kivu.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Idolobha libuye libe isiqu sokugibela intabamlilo iNyiragongo kanye nokunye kokulandelela amaGorila waseNtabeni okubiza kancane kunakho konke e-Afrika.
hypothesis: Imuzi nayo yindawo yokuhamba eNyiragongo volcano, kanye ne-Mountain Gorilla tracking engabizi kakhulu e-Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Uma usebenzisa i-boda-boda (itekisi lesithuthuthu) ukuhambahamba eGoma. Inani elivamile (lasendaweni) u-~500 wama-Franc wase-Congo uma ufuna uhambo olufishane.
hypothesis: Ungasebenzisa i-boda-boda (imoto yesithuthi) ukuhamba ngeGoma. Intengo ejwayelekile (yendawo) yi ~500 Congolese Francs ukuhamba esifushane.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Kuhlanganiswe nokungafinyeleleki kuyo kalula, "iTimbuktu" seyisetshenziswa njengesingathekiso samazwe angajwayelekile, akude.
hypothesis: Kuhlangene nekhwalithi yayo engafinyeleleki, "Timbuktu" isibe isifinyezo sezindawo ezikude kakhulu.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Namuhla, iTimbuktu idolobha eliphundlekile, nakuba idumela lalo lilenza lithandwe izivakashi, futhi linesikhumulo sezindiza.
hypothesis: Namuhla, iTimbuktu is a town elahlekileyo, noma kunjalo, idume njengesikhumbuzo sezokuvakasha, futhi ine sezindiza.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Ngo-1990, yafakwa ohlwini lwezindawo zefa lomhlaba ezisengozini, ngenxa yosongo lwesihlabathi sasohlane.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-1990, kwanezelwa kuluhlu lwezindawo zomhlaba zomdabu eziyingozi, ngenxa yezinga leentshonalanga zomhlaba.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Kwakungenye yezindawo zokuma phakathi nohlelo lwePBs lukaHenry Louis Gates lweZimangaliso Zezwe lase-Afrika.
hypothesis: Kwakuyinyanga enkulu eHenry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: Idolobha lihlukile ngokuphelele kwamanye amadolobha ezwe, ngoba linomoya wase-Arabhiya kakhulu ukudlula owaseAfrika.
hypothesis: Umasi wasekhona kwezinye izindawo zomhlaba, ngoba unomumo we-Arabic kunomumo we-African.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: IKruger National Park (KNP) isenyakatho-mpumalanga yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihamba ngasemngceleni weMozambique empumalanga, iZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele ongaseningizimu iCrocodile River.
hypothesis: U-Kruger National Park (KNP) liseNorth-East of South Africa futhi udlulela emaphethelweni weMozambique empumalanga, eZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele waseNingizimu Afrika enyakatho ungaphansi kweMfuleni weCrocodile.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Ubukhulu bepaki bungu-19,500 km² futhi lihlukaniswe laba yizindawo ezingokwemvelo ezingu-14, ngayinye inezidalwa zasendle ezihlukahlukene.
hypothesis: Ukuvalela i-park ingqikithi 19,500 km² futhi ihlukaniswe 14 ecozones ezahlukene, zonke zisekela ezahlukene zezilwane.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Ingenye yezindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi ithathwa njengendawo eyaziwa kakhulu kumaPaki weZwe waseNingizimu Afrika (SANParks).
hypothesis: Kuyinyathelo eliphambili laseNingizimu Afrika futhi kubhekwa njengenye yezinto eziphambili zeSouth African National Parks (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Njengawo wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika, kunamanani okuhlanga ngaphakathi usuku ngalunye kanye namanani okungena wepaki.
hypothesis: Kanye nezikhumulo zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika, kukhona imali yokubuyisela nokungena yezokuvikela yezikhumulo nsuku zonke.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Kungabuye kuzuzise ukuba umuntu athenge iWild Card, elimvumela ukungena kwelinye lamapaki okungakhethwa kuwo waseNingizimu Afrika noma wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika.
hypothesis: Kungenzeka kube luncedo ukuthenga iWild Card, enikeza ukungena kwezikhethiwe zama-parks eNingizimu Afrika noma zonke i-Parks eziPhakathi kweNingizimu Afrika.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Isiqhingi saseHong Kong sinika indawo yaseHong Kong igama layo futhi yindawo leyo izivakashi eziningi eziyithatha njengendawo yokuvakashelwa eyinhloko.
hypothesis: Hong Kong Island unikeza indawo yaseHong Kong igama layo futhi yindawo abatshali abaningi bayibhekile njenge focus main.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Ipharedi yamabhilidi enza umugqa wesibhakabhaka sase-Hong Kong ifaniswe neshadi lebha elikhazimulayo elibonakala ngokuba khona kwamanzi ase-Victoria Harbour.
hypothesis: Ukukhangisa kwamakhanda okwenza uphawu lweHong Kong skyline kuye kwafaniswa nebar chart elibonakalayo ngenxa yokubonakala kwamanzi eVictoria Harbour.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Ukuze ube nemibono emihle kakhulu ye-Hong Kong, shiya lesi siqhingi uye echibini lamanzi lase-Kowloon eliqondene.
hypothesis: Ukuze uthole umbono omuhle kakhulu weHong Kong, shiya isiqhingi futhi uye eKowloon waterfront okuphambene.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Iningi kokuthuthuka kwase-Hong Kong Island kugcwele ezweni elisanda kubuyiswa futhi ogwini olusenyakatho.
hypothesis: Iningi lezakhiwo zomuzi zaseHong Kong Island lilinganiselwe kakhulu emhlabathini olubuyiselweyo emhlabeni osezingeni eliphezulu enyakatho.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Le indawo abenzi bamakoloni baseBrithani abayithatha njengendawo yabo ngakho uma ufuna ukubona ubufakazi besikhathi esedlule sobukoloni salendawo, lena indawo efanele ongaqala kuyo.
hypothesis: Le ndawo yaba yeyabantu baseBrithani abazithobela khona, ngakho uma ufuna ubufakazi bokuthi le ndawo ibizwa ngokuthi 'yasekoloni', lapha ungase uqale khona.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Ama-Sundarban awuchungechunge lomhlume wothungulu omkhulu kunawo wonke emhlabeni, ayindawo engama-80 km (50 mi) ukuya phakathi nezwe laseBangladesh nelaseNdiya kusuka ogwini.
hypothesis: Imi Sundarbans yindawo enkulu yezindawo ze-mangrove ezingaphansi kwamanzi emhlabeni, ehlukaniswe nge-80 km (50 mi) emhlabeni waseBangladesh ne-India.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: I-Sundarbans ibhekwe njengeNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba i-UNESCO. Ingxenye yehlathi elisensimini yabaseNdiya libizwa ngokuthi i-Ipaki Lesizwe i-Sundarbans
hypothesis: ISundarbans senzelwe njengeSithili seMzantsi ye-UNESCO. Inxalenye yomthi osezantsi kwilizwe lase-India ibizwa ngokuthi yiSundarbans National Park.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Amahlathi awagcini nje ngokuba amaxhaphozi anemihlume — ahlanganisa ezinye zezindawo zokugcina ezisele zamahlathi anamandla ake ahlanganisa ithafa lase-Gangetic.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Ama-Sundarbans enza indawo engama-3,850 km², leyo ingxenye yesithathu yayo yembozwe yizindawo ezingamanzi/ubhuku.
hypothesis: Imi Sundarbans ihlanganisa indawo engama-3,850 km², engaphezu kwesigamu esitholakala emanzini/indawo yamanzi.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Kusukela ngo-1966 amaSundarbans abeyindawo yokuhlala izilwane zasendle, futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi manje sekunamahlosi waseBukhosini wase-Bengal kanye nezinyamazane ezinamabala ezicishe zibe ngu-30,000 endaweni.
hypothesis: Kusukela ngo-1966 i-Sundarbans ibe yindawo yokuvikela imvelo, futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi manje kukhona ama-400 Royal Bengal tigers kanye nama-30,000 amahlanza asezingeni elisemthethweni endaweni.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Amabhasi asuka esiteshi samabhasi esiphakathi kwesifunda (ngaphesheya komfula) usuku lonke, nakuba amaningi, ikakhulukazi lawo aya ngasempumalanga naseJakar/Bumthang asuka phakathi kuka-06:30 no-07:30.
hypothesis: Imibhasi ivela esiteshini samabhasi esifundeni (ngaphesheya kwemifula) imini yonke, nakuba iningi, ikakhulukazi labo elihambela empumalanga neJakar/Bumthang, liphuma phakathi kuka 06:30 no 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Njengoba amabhasi esifunda ngokuvamile egcwala, kuyatuseka ukuthi uthenge ithikithi ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambili.
hypothesis: Ngoba izindiza phakathi kwesifunda zihlale zigcwele, kunconywa ukuthi uthenge ithikithi izinsuku ezimbalwa ngaphambili.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Izigodi eziningi zikhonzwa amaBhasi we-Coaster waseJapani amancane, anethezekile naqinile.
hypothesis: Iningi lezifunda zilawulwa yizindiza zezimoto ezincane ze-Japanese Coaster, eziqinile futhi zinamandla.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Amatekisi ahlanganyelwayo ayindlela esheshayo nenethezekile yokuya ezindaweni eziseduze, njengase-Paro (Nu 150) kanye nase-Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Amatye amahhala yindlela esheshayo neyokuthula yokuhamba kwezindawo eziseduze, njengeParo (Nu 150) nePunakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: I-Oyapock River Bridge ibhuloho eliphaswe ngamakhebula ensimbi. Liwelela uMfula i-Oyapock uhlanganisa amadolobha ase-Oiapque eBrazil kanye neSaint-Georges de I'Oyapock eFrench Guiana.
hypothesis: U-Oyapock River Bridge yisikhumulo samanzi esikhethekile. Umgwaqo usukela emfuleni u-Oyapock ukuze uxhume amadolobha ase-Oiapoque eBrazil ne-Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock eFrench Guiana.
