source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Ama-Guarani bekuyiqembu lomdabu eliphawulekayo elinefa kulokho manje okuthiwa iMpumalanga Paraguay, baphila ngokuba abazingeli futhi bathola ukudla ngokulima.
hypothesis: Abantu baseGuaraní babeyisigaba esibaluleke kakhulu sabantu basekhaya abaseParaguay, abahlala njengezilwane ezizungezile ezingaphila ngokuzithandela, futhi abasebenzise ukulima.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Indawo yaseChaco bekuyikhaya lamanye amaqembu wezizwana zemdabu njengamaGuaycurú kanye namaPayaguá, ababephila ngokuzingela, ukubutha kanye nokudoba.
hypothesis: Umbutho weChaco wayeyindawo yezinye izizwe zesizwe, njengeGuaycurú nePayaguá, abaphila ngokudubula, ukukhuphela nokudoba.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Ngekhulu lama-16 leminyaka iParaguay, ngaphambili eyayibizwa ngokuthi "Isifundazwe Esikhulukazi sama-Indie", yaba khona ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabanqobi baseSpeyini namaqembu abantu bomdabu ngokuzalwa.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka we-16th, eParaguay, eyayibizwa ngokuthi "I-Indies yaseGiant", yavela ngenxa yokuhlangana kwamaSpanish abaholi namaqembu amazwe angaphandle.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: AbaseSpeyini baqala isikhathi sobukoloni esathatha amakhulu amathathu eminyaka.
hypothesis: AbaseSpanishi baqala isikhathi sokuhlaliswa kwabantu esazungeza iminyaka engamakhulu amathathu.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Kusukela ekusungulweni kwe Asunción ngo-1537, i-Paraguay yakwazi ukugcina isimo sayo sendabuko esikhulu kanye nobukhona bayo.
hypothesis: Kusukela kwasekwa kwe-Asunción ngo-1537, i-Paraguay isebenzise ukugcina iningi yomlando wayo yasekhaya neyomdabu.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: I-Argentina idume ngokuba nelinye lamaqembu kanye nabadlali be-polo abahamba phambili emhlabeni.
hypothesis: Argentina iyaziwa kahle ngokuba neqembu elihle kakhulu lezinkanyezi kanye nabadlali bomdlalo we-polo emhlabeni.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Umncintiswano omkhulu kunayo yonke wonyaka wenzeka ngoDisemba ezinkundleni ze-polo eLas Cañitas.
hypothesis: Inyanga kaDisemba kuzoba khona umncintiswano omkhulu wonyaka eLas Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Imincintiswano emincane kanye nemidlalo ingabuye ibonwe lapha ngezinye izikhathi zonyaka.
hypothesis: Imidlalo encane nezincane zingabonwa lapha ngesikhathi esifanayo.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Ukuze uthole izindaba zemincintiswano kanye nendawo yokuthenga amathikithi wemidlalo yepholo, hlola i-Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: Ukuze uthole izindaba mayelana nezinkundla kanye nokuthenga amathikithi e-polo imidlalo, hlola i-Asociacion Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Imali esemthethweni yase-Falkland iwupondo waseFalkland (FKP) inani layo libekwe endaweni efanayo nopondo waseBrithani (GBP).
hypothesis: Imali esemthethweni ye-Falklands yi-Falkland pound (FKP) enezinhlamvu eziyifanele zomlingo waseBrithani (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Imali ingashintshwa ebhange okuwukuphela kwalo esiqhingini esiseStanley ngaphesheya kwesitolo saseFIC Ntshonalanga.
hypothesis: Imali ingathengwa esibambeni esisodwa esifundeni esinamadlelo, esiseStanley, esiphambene neFIC West esitolo.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Amaphawundi wase-Britain ngokuvamile azokwamukelwa noma yikuphi eziqhingini futhi nangaphakathi amakhadi wesikweletu e-Stanley kanye namadola ase-United States nawo ajwayele ukwamukelwa.
hypothesis: Imali ye-Pounds ye-British izokwamukelwa kuyo yonke imizi emikhulu kanye ne-Stanley credit cards kanye ne-United States dollars zivumelekile futhi.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Eziqhingini eziqhelile amakhadi wokuthenga ngesikweletu cishe ngeke amukelwe, nakuba imali yaseBrithani naseMelika ingathathwa; hlola nabanikazi kusengaphambili ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela yokukhokha eyamukelwayo.
hypothesis: Kwiindawo ezingaphandle kwamanzi amakhadi esikweletu awuzukwamkelwa, nangona iBritish neUnited States lwemali ingathathwa; qinisekisa kunye nabaphathi kwangaphambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuba yintoni indlela yokuhlawula esebenzayo.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Cishe akwenzeki ukushintshelana imali yaseFalklands ngaphandlwe kweziqhingi, ngakho-ke shintshelana imali ngaphambi kokuhamba eziqhingini.
hypothesis: Kukhona cishe okungenzeki kokutshintshwa kwemali ye-Falklands ngaphandle kwamaqonga, ngoko shintsha imali yakho phambi kokushiya amaqonga.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Njengoba i-Montevideo iseningizimu yeNkabazwe, kuba ihlobo lapho ngesikhathi Ingxenye eseNyakatho kusebusika kuyaphambana.
hypothesis: Ngoba iMontevideo iseningizimu ye-Equator, kuyinto ehlobo khona lapho kuyintwasahlobo eNingizimu yeHemisphere futhi vice versa.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: IMontevideo isezindaweni eseduze namatropiki; ngezinyanga zasehlobo, amazinga okushisa angaphezu kuka-+30°C avamile.
hypothesis: IMontevideo is in the subtropics; emasontweni ashubile, amakhaza avela phezulu +30°C aqhelekile.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Ubusika bungaba nzima kakhulu: amazing okushisa angase adlulele ngale kweqhwa, kodwa umoya kanye nomswakama sekuhlangene kwenza kubande ngaphezu kwalokho isikali sokushisa esikushoyo.
hypothesis: Ubusika bangabonakala abandayo: amanani abekelele phansi, kodwa umoya nobumnandi bayo banxanye bayenze bafune kangcono kunalokho okushiwo yizibalo.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Azikho izikhathi eziqondile “zemvula” noma “zobusika”: izinga lemvula lihlala linjalo cishe unyaka wonke.
hypothesis: Kukhona okungenani "inzima" ne-"omile" izikhathi: inani lemvula lihlala lilinganiselwe kakhulu unyaka wonke.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Nakuba izilwane eziningi epaki zijwayele ukubona abantu, izilwane zasendle noma kunjalo aziphucukile futhi akumelwe zondliwe noma ziphazanyiswe.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma iningi lezilwane esipheniwe luyadlula ukubona abantu, umhlaba wemvelo uyadlula futhi kumele ungadliwe noma ungadluliselwe.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Ngokweziphathimandla zepaki, hlala okungenani amayadi/amamitha angu-100 kude namabhere kanye nezimpisi ezifana namanketshane futhi amayadi/amamitha angu-25 kude nezinye izilwane zasendle!
hypothesis: Ngokusho kwamalungelo esiphezulu esigodini, yigcine ubude obuyi-100 amamitha/izinyawo ezingaphezu kuka-100 kusuka kubheke emadlelweni nasezilwaneni zezilwane zasendle! Yigcine ubude obuyi-25 amamitha/izinyawo kusuka kubheke kwezinye izilwane zasendle!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zibukeka zithobile kangakanani, izinyathi zaseMelika, ama-elk, ama-moose, amabhere, futhi cishe nazo zonke izilwane ezinkulu zingahlasela.
hypothesis: Kungaba yilokho noma yini, i-bison, i-Elk, i-moose, i-bears, ne-nearly zonke izilwane ezinkulu zingadlula.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Unyaka ngamunye, izivakashi eziningi ziyalimala ngenxa yokuthi azigcinanga ibanga elifanele. Lezi zilwane zinkulu, ezasendle, futhi zingaba ingozi, ngakho zinike isikhala sazo.
hypothesis: Ngonyaka ngamunye, amadoda amaningana atholakale enyamalala ngoba abengawuhambisani nendawo efanele. Lezi zilwane ziyinkimbinkimbi, ziyindawo engcwele, futhi zingaba yingozi, ngakho-ke zinike indawo yazo.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Ngaphezu kwalokho, phawula ukuthi iphunga libiza amabhere kanye nezinye izilwane zasendle, ngakho gwema ukuphatha noma ukupheka ukudla okunephunga futhi ugcine ikamu lihlanzekile.
hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwalokho, qaphela ukuthi amafutha athola izilwane ezifana nebhadi nezinye izilwane, ngakho-ke zonke izinto ezinamafutha zingabalelwa futhi zonke izinto eziphekiwe zingasuswa. Qiniseka ukuthi indawo yakho yehlile.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: I-Apia inhlokodolobha yaseSamoa. Idolobha lisesiqhingini sase-Upolu futhi linabantu abangaphansi nje kuka-40,000.
hypothesis: Apia yindawo enkulu yaseSamoa. Isixeko siyasekwa kwiIsland of Upolu kwaye sinabantu abangaphantsi kwe-40,000.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: I-Aphiya yasungulwa ngawo-1850 futhi yaba yinhlokodolobha engokomthetho yaseSamowa kusukela ngo-1959.
hypothesis: U-Apia wasekwa ngo-1850s futhi isibe yisihlalo esemthethweni seSamoa kusukela ngo-1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Itheku bekuyindawo yempi esabekalo yemikhumbi lapho kwakuhlangene izaqha khona ngo-1889 lapho imikhumbi eyisikhombisa yaseJalimane, eMelika, kanye naseBrithani yenqabe ukusuka ethekwini.
hypothesis: Umlenze kwaba yisikhundla esibi se-1889 se-Naval standoff lapho izikebhe eziyisikhombisa zase-Germany, US, ne-Britain zizwa zingaziphumi emlweni.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Yonke imikhumbi yacwila, ngaphandle komkhumbi owodwa wase-Britain. Cishe abantu abangu-200 baseMelika naseJalimane balahlekelwa yizimpilo zabo.
hypothesis: Bonke izikebhe zawa, ngaphandle kwesinye isikhwama seBritish. Phantse 200 ubomi lwaseMelika neJalimane lwahlulwa.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Phakathi nomzabalazo wokuzimela ohlelwe yinhlangano kaMau, umhlangano wokuthula edolobheni waholela ekubulaweni kwenkosi yezwe uTupua Tamasese lealofi III.
hypothesis: Ngexesha lomzabalazo wokuzimela oluqanjwe nguMau Movement, umhlangano wokuthula emzini waphuma ngenxa yokubulawa kukaTupua Tamasese Lealofi III, inkosi enkulu.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Kunezingu eziningi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland ingapha nangapha kwamatheku amabili. Ezithandwa kakhulu zisezindaweni ezintathu.
hypothesis: Kunezindawo eziningi zomlilo, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland isebenzisa amaholide amabili. Ezithandekayo kakhulu zisezindaweni ezintathu.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Amabhisi wasoGwini oluseNyakatho (esifundeni seTheku eliseNyakatho) asoLwandlekazini lwePhasifiki futhi asuka e-Long Bay ngasenyakatho kuya e-Devonport eningizimu.
hypothesis: Imiphakathi yaseNorth Shore (eNorth Harbour) is on the Pacific Ocean futhi isukela eLong Bay enyakatho kuya eDevonport eseningizimu.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Kucishe kube izingu ezinesihlabathi eziyindawo ephephile yokubhukuda, kanti kugcwele nemithunzi eyenziwa izihlahla ze-pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Kukhona cishe wonke amabhishi sandy futhi anokwethenjelwa swimming, futhi iningi liyatholakala shades amahle amahlathi pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Izingu zase-Tamaki Drive ziseThekwini lase-Waitemata, edolobheni labadla izambane likapondo e-Mission Bay naseSt Heliers e–Auckland eMaphakathi.
hypothesis: Amabhishi e Tamaki Drive asezindaweni zokudlela eziphakeme ze Waitemata Harbour, e Mission Bay ne St Heliers e Central Auckland.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Lawa amabhishi wemindeni aba nabantu abaningi ngezinye izikhathi anezitolo ezihlukahlukene ezigcwele ogwini. Ukubhukuda kuphephile.
hypothesis: Lezi ziyingozi futhi zihlanganiswe ngamalungu omndeni, enezindawo zokuthenga ezinhle emhlabeni. Ukuhamba kwamanzi kuyimfihlo.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Ubhiya oyinhloko wasekhaya ‘Uhamba Phambili’, awuwona ubhiya oyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa umnandi futhi uyaqabula. Omunye ubhiya wasekhaya ubizwa ngokuthi “i-Manta”.
hypothesis: Inkosi yasekhaya i-Number One, ayikho iwayini elinamandla kodwa elithakazelisayo. Enye iwayini yasekhaya ithi "Manta".

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Kunamawayini amaningi waseFulansi okuphuzwa, kodwa amawayini waseNyuzilandi kanye nase-Australia angahamba kangcono.
hypothesis: Kukhona amawina amaningi aseFrance aphuma khona, kodwa amawina aseNew Zealand ne-Australia angahamba kahle.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Amanzi asempompini yomphakathi aphephe ngokuphelele ukuthi aphuzwe, kodwa amanzi athengwayo atholakala kalula uma unokwesaba.
hypothesis: Amanzi wendawo awasebenzi, kodwa amanzi okuphuza angatholakala kalula uma unomona.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Kubantu base-Australia, umcabango wekhofi 'elinobisi oluthunqiswe ngomusi' awujwayelekile. Inkomishi encane 'yi-espresso', i-cappuccino iza igcwele ukhilimu ophezulu (hhayi ugwebu), futhi itiye liphuzwa ngaphandle kobisi.
hypothesis: Kubantu base-Australia, umbono we-'flat white' ikhofi ungaziwa. I-'short black' 'yisiphothi', i-cappuccino ivela enyameni enkulu yobisi (hhayi i-froth), futhi itiye livunyelwe ngaphandle kwamkhiwane.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Isiphuzo sikashokoledi esishisayo sisemazingeni waseBelgium. Iziphuzo ezenziwe ngezithelo ziyabiza kodwa zikahle kakhulu.
hypothesis: Ukhozi olufudumeleyo luselwa ngokwamaqhosha aseBelgium. Iziphuzo zeziqhamo zinikezwa ngamanani aphakeme kodwa zilungile.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Uhambo oluningi lokuya emkhombeni wekholali (reef) lwenziwa unyaka wonke, futhi izingozi ngenxa yanoma iziphi yalezi zimbangela zasemkhombeni azivamile.
hypothesis: Inyanga zonke, amathrekhi amaningi aya eziqongweni, futhi ukulimala ngenxa yalokhu kwenziwa eziqongweni kuyinto engavamile.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Noma kunjalo, thatha iseluleko seziphathimandla, ulandele zonke izinkomba futhi unakisise izixwayiso sokuphepha.
hypothesis: Ngisho, uthathe iseluleko kusuka kubantu abanolwazi, ulalele zonke izimpawu, futhi unakekele izilaleli zokuphepha.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Ama-jellyfish asabhokisi abakhona eduze namabhishi naseduze nezizalo zemifula kusukela ngo-October kuya ku-April enyakatho ye-1770. Angatholakala ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwalezi zikhathi.
hypothesis: Ukubukwa kwe-Box jellyfish kufumaneka ezingeni elikufutshane neelwandle kwaye ezingeni elikufutshane kwiindawo zomlambo ukusuka ngo-Okthobha ukuya ngo-Apreli ngasentla kwe-1770. Zingabonakala ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwale mihla.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Oshaka abekho, nokho abavamisile ukuhlasela abantu. Oshaka abaningi besaba abantu futhi bazobhukuda babaleke.
hypothesis: Amagagasi asekhona, kodwa abathintekayo abantu. Iningi lamagagasi liyakukhathazeka ngabantu futhi liyakudlula.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Izingwenya zamanzi anosawoti azihlali ngokukhululeka olwandle, indawo yazo yokuhlala eyinhloko kusezizalweni zomfula enyakatho kusuka e-Rockhampton.
hypothesis: Amagundane amanzi abasolwandle abangasebenzi kakhulu emhlabeni wasezulwini, indawo yabo eyinhloko yindawo yasezintabeni ezingasentla kweRockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Ukubhukha kusenesikhathi kunikeza isihambi ukuthula kwengqondo kokuthi sizoba nendawo yokulala kuyo lapho sifika endaweni esiya kuyo.
hypothesis: Ukubhukha kwangaphambili kunikeza umuntu uxhumene nomoya wokuthula ukuthi uzakuba nomuzi wokulala uma efeza endaweni yakhe.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo kaningi ziba nezaphulelo namahhotela athile, nakuba ungakwazi ukubhukha ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlala, njengendawo yamakamu, ngenkampani ehlela uhambo.
hypothesis: Agents travel ngokuvamile babe izinsiza ezithile amahhotela, noma kunjalo ungase uthole kungenzeka ukubhuka ezinye izindawo zokuhlala, ezifana amakamelo okuhlala, nge agent travel.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo zinikeza inhlanganisela yezinto ezihlanganisa ibhulakufesi, amalungiselelo wezinto zokuthutha zokuya/zokusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma isethi ehlangene yendiza kanye nehhotela.
hypothesis: Umbukiso wezindiza ngokuvamile unikeza amaphakheji afaka ukudla kwasekuseni, izinkontileka zokuhamba ukuze / kusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma amaphakheji ahlanganiswe wezindiza nehotela.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Bayakwazi ukukugcinela indawo uma wena usadinga isikhathi sokucabanga noma usafisa ukulungisa izinto ezithinta uhambo lwakho (isibonelo i-visa).
hypothesis: Bangabakwazi futhi ukubamba isibhengezo ngawe uma udinga isikhathi sokucabanga ngomnikelo noma ukuqoqa amadokhumenti eza endaweni yakho (isib. ivisa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Noma iziphi izinguquko noma izicelo nokho kumelwe zidluliselwe enkampanini ehlela uhambo kuqala futhi hhayi nehhotela ngokuqondile.
hypothesis: Yiziphi iziphakamiso noma izicelo, noma yiziphi izicelo, kufanele zicatshangelwe ngokucophelela yize zingenele umthengisi wezokuhamba kanye nalokhu engenziwa ngqo ngenhla yehhotela.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Kweminye imikhosi, iningi lababakhona emkhosini womculo linquma ukukanisa kuleyo ndawo, futhi ababakhona abaningi bakubona kuyingxenye edingekayo yokuhlanganyela.
hypothesis: Kwezinye imikhosi, iningi labahambi bezemidlalo bakhetha ukukhempa endaweni, futhi abahambi abaningi babucabanga njengengxenye ebalulekile yomlando.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Uma ufuna ukubona okwenzekayo useduze kuzomelwe ufike masinya ukuze uthole indawo yokukamisa eduze nomculo.
hypothesis: Uma ufuna ukuba eduze kwentuthuko kuzodingeka ufake ekuseni ukuze uthole indawo yokuhlala eduze nomculo.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo osesiteji esiyinhloko ungaphela, kungaba nezingxenye zomkhosi ezizoqhubeka zidlala umculo kuze kube sebusuku kakhulu.
hypothesis: Qaphela ukuthi nakuba umculo esizunguza esiteji esiyinhloko siye safinyelela ekugcineni, kunezinye izindawo zomkhosi lapho umculo uzogcina usetshenziswa kwesokudla ebusuku.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Eminye imikhosi inezindawo zokukanisa ezikhethekile zemindeni enezingane ezincane.
hypothesis: Amasonto athile ane amagumbi okuhlala okhethekileyo abantu abanezingane ezincane.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Uma unqamula iNyakatho Baltic ebusika, bheka ukuthi ikuphi indawo yokusandlwana okwakhiwe ngezingodo, njengoba ukuhamba eqhweni kubangela ukungaphatheki kahle emakhaleni kulaba abathinteke kakhulu.
hypothesis: Ukuba ukuhamba ngasentla Baltic ebusika, qinisekisa indawo cabin, njengoko ukuhamba ngaphantsi kwamanzi ice kubangela kakhulu ingxolo abo kakhulu zinomthelela.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Uhambo lomkhumbi lwaseSaint Petersburg luhlanganisa idolobha. Kulindelwe ukuthi abahamba ngomkhumbi bahlangabezane nezimfuneko ze-visa (hlola imigomo)
hypothesis: Ukuhamba kweSt Petersburg kuhlanganisa isikhathi esithile emzini. Abagibeli bezindiza bayavunyelwa ukuba bangaphazamiseki kwi-visa requirements (hlanganisa imigomo).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Amahhlo okugembula ngokujwayelekile enza imizamo yokuba izivakashi zichithe isikhathi nemali eningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Amafasitela namakilogo ngokuvamile awekho, futhi kungaba nzima ukuthola izindawo zokuphuma.
hypothesis: Amakhazikazi ngokuvamile enze imizamo eminingi ukuze kuthuthukiswe isikhathi nemali esetshenziswa ngabagibeli. Amawindi kanye nekhompyutha yezikhathi zivame ukungabikho, futhi izindlela zokuphuma zivame ukuba zinzima ukuthola.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Ngokuvamile banokudla okukhethekile, iziphuzo kanye nokuzijabulisa, ukuze bagcine izivakashi zithokozile, futhi bazigcine ziphakathi kwawo.
hypothesis: Abantu abanawo ngokuvamile ukunikeza ukudla okukhethekile, ukuphuza, nemidlalo yokuzijabulisa, ukuze abagibeli babonakale bejabule, futhi babekwe endaweni.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Ezinye izindawo zihlinzeka ngotshwala ezindlini. Nokho, ukudakwa kudunga ingqondo, bonke abantu abagembulayo abahle bayakwazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala usangulukile.
hypothesis: Abanye amasayithi anikeza iziphuzo eziphuzwayo mahhala. Nokho, ukudakwa kuyabandakanya ukungahambisani, futhi wonke umdlali omuhle uyazi ukubaluleka kokuba sobhuza.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Noma ubani ozoshayela ezindaweni eziphakeme noma ngaphezu kwezintuba zezintaba kumelwe alindele ukuba khona kwesithwathwa, iqhwa, noma amakhaza ashubisa umkantsha.
hypothesis: Abantu abayohlwaya ezingeni eliphakeme noma emigwaqeni yezintaba kufanele bacinge ukuthi kungaba khona iqhwa, ice, noma izinga lokushisa eliphansi.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Emigwaqweni eneqhwa kanye nomkhithiko, ukuhamba kuyabambezeleka futhi angeke ukwazi ukushayela njengalapho uhamba otiyeleni.
hypothesis: Emgwaqeni ebandayo neqhwa, ukuncishiswa kwezinto okwenzekayo kuyancipha futhi awukwazi ukushayela njengokuba ungase ungaphandle kwemigwaqo.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Uma kunomoya ohambisana neqhwa, kungawa iqhwa elanele elingakwenza ubhajwe ngesikhashana nje.
hypothesis: Ngexesha leentaba, iqhwa elaneleyo ukuze uthiwe umiwe kungabikho ixesha elifutshane.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Ukubonakala kungavinjelwa ukuwa noma ukufuthwa kweqhwa noma noma ngomswakama noma iqhwa efasiteleni lemoto.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zeqhwa noma zesithwathwa zivamile emazweni amaningi, futhi izimoto zihamba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka cishe unyaka wonke.
hypothesis: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amazwe amaningi anesimo esifudumele neqhwa, futhi ukuhamba kwemoto kuhamba ngokuphumelelayo kuzungeze unyaka wonke.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Amasafari mhlawumbe yinto enkulu kunazo zonke edonsa izivakashi e-Afrika futhi yinto ethandwa yizivakashi eziningi.
hypothesis: Ukuvakashela i-Safaris kungenzeka kube yisibonelo esikhulu se-tourism e-Afrika futhi kuyisibonelo esikhulu sokubona abavakashi abaningi.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Igama elithi safari ngokuvamile lisetshenziselwa ukubhekisela ohambweni lokunqamula izwe ukuze ubone izilwane zasendle ezihlaba umxhwele zase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emathafeni.
hypothesis: In popular use, iSafarhi lithetha ukuhamba ngezinyawo ukuze ubone imvelaphi yase-Afrika enkulu, ikakhulukazi emadlelweni.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Ezinye izilwane, njengezindlovu kanye nezindlulamithi, zithanda ukusondela ezimotweni futhi izinto zokubuka ezisezingeni elikahle zizokuvumela ukuthi uzibuke kahle.
hypothesis: Amanye izilwane, njengezimbuzi nezigwegwe, zivame ukuhlobana kufuphi nezimoto. Imishini esezingeni eliphakeme izokuvumela ukubukwa okuhle.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Amabhubesi, izingulule kanye nezingwe ziyexwaya futhi uzozibona kangcono ngezingilazi zokubuka kude.
hypothesis: Imbali, iCheetahs neLeopards ngezinye izikhathi zibuhlungu futhi uzobona kahle ngebinoculars.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Uhambo lokunqamula izwe lwezinyawo (olubuye lwaziwe ngokuthi "ukuhamba ehlathini", "i-safari yokuhamba ngezinyawo", noma "ukukhenketha") luhlanganisa uhambo olude lwezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningana.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba nge-safari (eyaziwa nangokuthi "ukuhamba nge-bush", "ukuhamba nge-hiking", noma "ukuhamba nge-footing") kuhlanganisa ukuhamba, noma amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningi.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Ama-Paralympic azokwenzeka kusukela ngomhla ka-24 Agasti kuya ku-5 Septemba 2021. Ezinye izehlakalo zizobanjelwa kwezinye izindawo eJapani yonke.
hypothesis: Imiphumela ye-Paralympic izokwenzeka kusukela ngo-24 Agasti kuya ku-5 Septhemba 2021. Ezinye izenzakalo zizokwenzeka kwezinye izindawo eJapane.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: ITokyo kuzoba ilona kuphela idolobha lase-Asia eliphathe imidlalo yama-Olimpiki wasehlobo emibili, eliyiphathe ngo-1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo ngeke ibe yedwa emzini wase-Asia owawo umcimbi we-Olympic wezulu, owawo umcimbi we-1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Uma ubhukhe indiza kanye nendawo yokulala ngo-2020 ngaphambi kokuthi kumenyezelwe ukuhlehliswa, ungase ube sesimweni esinzima.
hypothesis: Uma uke wabukela izindiza zakho nezindawo zokuhlala ze-2020 ngaphambi kokushicilelwa kwesigaba esithi "Postponed", ungase ube nesimo esibi.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Izinkambiso zokukhansela ziyahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaMashi izinkampiso eziningi zokukhansela ngenxa ye-coronavirus azifiki kuJulayi 2020, ngenkathi okwakuhlelwe ngayo ama-Olimpiki.
hypothesis: Imigomo yokucisha yahlukahluka, kepha njengamanje ngoMashi wokugcina imigomo yokucisha engaba ngekhulu le-2020, lapho i-Olympics ibikwe khona.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi amaningi womcimbi azobiza phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, futhi amathikithi avamile abiza u-¥7,000.
hypothesis: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi esenzakalo amaningi azobiza phakathi kuka ¥2,500 no ¥130,000, ngeamathikithi ejwayelekile ethwele inani elingama-¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Uku-ayina izingubo ezimanzi kungazisiza zome. Amahhotela amaningi ane-ayini nebhodi yoku-ayina etholakalayo ngokubolekwa, noma ngabe eyodwa ingekho egumbini.
hypothesis: Ukushisa izingubo ezomile kungasiza ukuba zibe mhlophe. Amahhotela amaningi anawo insimbi nebhodi yekhebula etholakalayo ukuze itholakale, noma kunjalo uma kungekho omunye ohlinzekileyo endaweni.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Uma i-ayina ingekho, noma uma ungagqoki amasokisi abizayo a-ayiniwe, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokomisa izinwele, uma ukhona.
hypothesis: Uma ungatholi isikhathi sokusebenzisa isikhathi esibucayi, noma ungathandi ukugqoka amasokisi ahlanzekile, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokushisa izinwele, uma kuyatholakala.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Qaphela ukuba ungavumeli indwangu ukuba ishise kakhulu (okungayenza ukuthi ishwaqe, noma ezimweni ezidlulele, ihamuke).
hypothesis: Qaphela ukuthi ungavumelekile ukuba ifayibha igeze kakhulu (okuyokuthi kudale ishukela, noma kwezinye izimo, kushiswe).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye ezisebenza kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile eziwusongo.
hypothesis: Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye ezinamandla kakhulu ngokumelene nezitho ezithile.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Kwezinye izindawo ukubilisa amanzi umzuzu kwanele, kwezinye kudingeka imizuzu eminingana.
hypothesis: Emazweni athile, ukushisa amanzi kwemizuzu embalwa kuyanele, eminye kudinga imizuzu eminingi.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Izihlungi ziyahluka ngempumelelo, uma ungaba nokukhathazeka, kumelwe ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi wakho ebhodleni elivaliwe enkampanini ethenjwayo.
hypothesis: Ukukhethwa kwama-filters kuyahlukahluka ngokuphumelelayo, futhi uma unemibuzo, kufanele ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi esikhwameni esivaliwe esivela enkampanini enokuthula.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Izihambi zingahlangabezana nezifo zezilwane ezingazijwaleyanga ezindaweni zangakuzo.
hypothesis: Abahambi bangase bafikelele kwiindawo zezilwanyana ezingazange zaziwa kwilizwe labo.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Izilokazane zingakonakalisa ukudla, zicasule, noma okubi nakakhulu zenze kusigulise, zisakaze ubuthi, noma zisakaze izifo.
hypothesis: Imicu ingadlulisa ukudla, ibangele ukudideka, noma okubi kakhulu ibangele ukukhathazeka, idlulise i-vom, noma ithumele izifo.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Izifo ezithelelwanayo ngokwazo, noma izilwane eziyingozi ezingalimaza noma zibulale umuntu ngamandla, azivamile ukufaneleka njengezilwane ezifuywayo.
hypothesis: Imithi engcolileyo yezifo, okanye izilwanyana ezinobungozi ezinokubangela ukulimala okanye ukubulala abantu ngamandla, azivumelekanga ngokuvamile ukuba zibe yiziphambano.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Ukuthenga izimpahla ezingakhokhiswa intela kuyithuba lokuthenga izimpahla ezikhishwe izintela kanye nentela yezimpahla ezindaweni ezithile.
hypothesis: Ukuhweba okungaphumeleli kuyinketho yokuthenga izimpahla ezingekho emthethweni kanye ne-excises endaweni ethile.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Izihambi eziya emazweni akhokhisa intela ephezulu kwesinye isikhathi zingonga imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezidakayo nogwayi.
hypothesis: Abahambi abafuna amazwe anamathelayo kakhulu anokuthi bagcine imali eninzi, ingakumbi kwiimveliso ezifana neziphuzo zokutya kunye neetabako.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Indawo ephakathi kwe-Point Marion ne-Fairmont yenza izimo zokushayela ezinzima kakhulu eMgwaqweni omkhulu wase-Buffalo-Pittsburgh, odlula njalo ezindaweni ezingenabantu zasemahlathini.
hypothesis: Ukukhuphukela phakathi kwe-Point Marion ne-Fairmont kubonisa imibandela eziyinkimbinkimbi zokushayela kwi-Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, ephuma kaningi emadlelweni ahlukene.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Uma ungajwayele ukushayela emigwaqweni yasemaphandleni, hlala uphapheme: izindawo eziyimiqansa kakhulu, izindlela eziwungcingo, kanye namajika amabi agcwele.
hypothesis: Uma ungazange udlulele emigwaqeni yasekhaya, qiniseka ukuthi uhlale usesimweni esihle: amagquma amade, amawele amancane, kanye nezintaba eziphakeme zizoba khona.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Ukulinganiselwa kwesivinini okusemabhodini kuphansi ngokuphawulekayo kunasezingxenyeni zangaphambili nezilandelayo — ngokuvamile u-35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — futhi ukukunakisisa kubalulekile nakakhulu kunokungakunakisisi.
hypothesis: Imikhawulo yokushaywa esibekwe ziyancipha kunezinye izingxenye ezingaphambilini nasezandleni — ngokuvamile 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — futhi ukuhlonipha kwabo kuyadingeka ngaphezu kwesinye isikhathi.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Ngokumangazayo, nokho, insiza yefoni ephathekayo inamandla kakhulu lapha kunezindlela eziningi eziningi zomzila, isibonelo, Izindawo Zasendle zasePennsylvania.
hypothesis: Ngokuyifuna, kunjalo, inkonzo yeselula inamandla kakhulu lapha kunamanye amasiko endleleni, isibonelo, i-Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Ukudla kwaseJalimane okubhakwayo kuhle empeleni, futhi eBavaria, kunothile futhi kuhlukile, kuyafana nalokho kwasendaweni engumakhelwane engaseningizimu, i-Austria.
hypothesis: Imbiza yamaJalimane iyamangalisa, futhi eBavaria, iyazizwa inengqondo futhi inezinhlobo eziningi, enjengezinye zezwe laseningizimu, e-Austria.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Ukudla okubhakwayo kwezithelo kuvamile, okunama-apula aphekwayo afakwa ezintweni ezibhakwayo unyaka wonke, kanye nama-cherry namapulamu evela ngehlobo.
hypothesis: Imikhiqizo yezithelo ziyaziwa, ne-Apples esheshayo kuzo zonke izikhathi, ne-Cherries ne-Plums ebonakala ngesikhathi somvula.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Okuningi kokudla kwaseJalimane okubhakiwe kubuye kube nama-almondi, izindlubu zomhezela, kanye nezinye izindlubu zemithi. Amakhekhe athandwayo avame ukuhambisana kahle kakhulu nenkomishi yekhofi enamandla.
hypothesis: Amathuba amaningi e-German baked goods aqukethe amakhowe, ama-hazelnuts, nezinye izinkuni. Amakhekhe adume kakhulu ahambisana nephunga eliqinile lekhofi.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Uma ufuna uphayi omncane kodwa onothile, zama lokho okubizwa kuye ngendawo ngokuthi iBerliner, iPfannkuchen noma iKrapfen.
hypothesis: Uma ufuna ezinye zokudla ezincane, kodwa eziyizintandokazi, zama okuthiwa yi-Berliner, Pfannkuchen noma Krapfen, kuye ngokuthi lapho okhona.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Ukhari yisidlo esisuselwa kumakhambi nezinongo, kuhlanganiswe ndawonye mhlawumbe nenyama noma imifino.
hypothesis: Ukugquma kuyisidlo esekelwe kwizithako zezitshalo kanye nezithako zokudla, kanye nenyama noma imifino.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Ukhari ungaba “manzi” noma “wome” kuya ngesikali samanzi.
hypothesis: Ukugquma kungaba "omile" noma "wet" kuye ngokuthi inani lamanzi.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: Izindawo ezimaphakathi nezwe zaseNyakatho neNdiya nePakistan, i-yogathi ivamise ukusetshenziswa ezitshuliwni; eNingizimu neNdiya kanye nasezindaweni ezinye ezisogwini zezwekazi, ubisi lukakhukhunathi luvamise ukusetshenziswa.
hypothesis: Emaphandleni aseNingizimu India nePakistan, i-yogurt isetshenziswa kakhulu emakhulwini; eNingizimu India neziqithi ezinye zezwekazi, i-coconut milk isetshenziswa kakhulu.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Ngeziqhingi ezingu-17,000 ongakhetha kuzo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia igama elihlanganisa izinhlobo eziningi zokudlwa kwendawo okutholakala ezweni lonke.
hypothesis: Ngokuba ne-17,000 iziqithi ukukhetha, ukutya Indonesian luhlobo olubanzi kwiinkcubeko zesizwe ezifumaneka kulo lonke elaseIndonesia.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Kodwa, uma lisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwenye incazelo, igama livame ukusho ukudla ekuqaleni okusuka ezingxenyeni ezimaphakathi kanye nezisempumalanga yesiqhingi esiyinhloko iJava.
hypothesis: Kodwa, uma isetshenziswa ngaphandle kweminye imininingwane, igama liyaziwa njengezokudla eziyisisekelo ezivela eJava yaseNtshonalanga naseMpumalanga.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Manje okutholakala kabanzi eqoqweni leziqhingi lonke, ukudla kwaseJava kuhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunongwe kalula, lapho isinongo esivelele kubantu baseJava kungamantongomane, upelepele, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela waseJava kakhukhunathi) kanye nezinye izinongo ezinamakha.
hypothesis: Manje kuyatholakala kakhulu kuyo yonke i-archipelago, i-Javanese cuisine inezinhlobo eziningi zokudla okumele zifakwe kalula, okubalwa kuzo ukunambitheka kwe-peanuts, chillies, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela we-coconut) kanye nezithako eziningi eziyinhloko.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Izitibili izinto zokusekela izinyawo zomgibeli ezilenga ezingxenyeni zonke zesihlalo sehhashi.
hypothesis: Amathawula yizinsika zomuntu ohamba ngezinyawo ezihambayo, eziyiswe phansi emhlabeni ngaphansi kwesihlalo.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Zinikeza ukuzinza emgibelini kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yamathuba okuba izinyawo zomgibeli zibhajwe kuzo.
hypothesis: Bayakunikeza ukuzinza okukhulu kwi-rider kodwa bangabangela ukwesaba ngenxa yezinga elingase lwe-rider's feet.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Uma umgibeli ewiswa yihashi kodwa unyawo lwakhe lubambeke esitibilini, angahuduleka uma ihhashi libaleka. Ukunciphisa lengozi, izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuphepha zingathathwa.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: IYurophu izwekali elincane ngokwesilinganiso kodwa elinamazwe amaningi azimele. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, ukuthatha uhambo emazweni amaningana kungasho ukubhalisela i-visa kanye nokudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona amaphasiphoti kaningana.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Ngenxa yethopholoji yangaphansi kwamanzi ukugeleza okubuyayo kugxile ezingxenyeni ezimbalwa ezijulile, futhi umsinga osheshayo emanzini ajulile ungakheka lapho.
hypothesis: Ngokwesimo semvelo esiphantsi kwamanzi, ukubuya kwamanzi kuhlanganiswe kwezinye izindawo ezijulile, futhi umthombo osheshayo wamanzi ojulile ungakwazi ukwakha khona.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngenxa yokukhathala kokuzama ukubhukuda uya emuva ngokuphambene nomsinga, okungaba yinto engenakwenzeka.
hypothesis: Iningi lezindlela zokufa zenzeka ngenxa yokukhathazeka ngokuzama ukubuyela emuva ngokumelene nomthombo, okungase kube yimposiso.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Ngokushesha ngemva kokuba uphuma emsingeni wamanzi, ukubhukudela emuva akusabi nzima ngokuvamile.
hypothesis: As soon as uvela kulezi, swimming emuva akuyona nzima kunalokho evamile.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Zama ukuqonda lapho ungabambekile khona futhi noma, kuye ngamakhono akho nokuthi uphawuliwe yini, ungathanda ukulinda ukutakulwa.
hypothesis: Zama ukubhekana nendawo lapho ungatholakali khona futhi, kuye ngokuthi unemisebenzi yakho futhi uma usukwaziwe, ungase ulinde ukusiza.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Ukuthuka ngoba usekhaya kuza kuqala kunalokho kuthuka okwenzeka uma uvakashele endaweni ongayazi (ngakho ukujabula kuba kuncane), kuthathe isikhathi, futhi kungaya ngokuya kwande.
hypothesis: Ukubuyela kwendawo yokungena kuyavela ngaphambi kokuba kubonakale ukushukela kwendawo yobumbano (kunesikhathi esincane sokuthandana), kuhlala isikhathi eside, futhi kungaba nzima kakhulu.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Izihambi ezikuthole kulula ukujwayela isiko elisha kwesinye isikhathi zikuthola kunzima ukujwayela isiko lazo lendabuko futhi.
hypothesis: Abahambi abanamandla okuzivumelanisa nezithethe zesintu esisha bavame ukuba nekhathuni elidelela ekubuyeni kwabo emvelweni yabo.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Lapho ubuyela ekhaya usuka phesheya, kuzodingeka ujwayele isiko elisha neminye yemikhuba yakho oyilahlile kusukela ezweni lakini.
hypothesis: Ukubuyela ekhaya emva kokuhlala kwamanye amazwe, uye wathobela isiko lesizwe esisha futhi ulahlekelwe ezinye izinto zakho zesiko lasekhaya.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Lapho uya phesheya okokuqala, abantu kungenzeka ukuthi babebekezela futhi beqonda, bazi ukuthi izivakashi uma zifika ezweni elisha zidinga ukujwayela.
hypothesis: Ukuba waya phesheya ekuqaleni, abantu babekwazi ukubekezelela futhi babekwazi, ngoba abahambi emazweni amasha badinga ukuzivumelanisa.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Abantu kungezeka bangalindeli ukuthi ukulinda kanye nokuqonda nakho kubalulekile ezivakashini ezibuyela ekhaya.
hypothesis: Abantu bangase bangazindla ukuthi ukubekezela nokuthola ukwazi kuyadingeka nakwezinye izindawo abahambela kuzo.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Umbukiso onxa-ntathu womsindo nokukhanya ungenye yezinto ezithakazelisayo endaweni yezingane.
hypothesis: Umbukiso wezwi nomlilo we-pyramid ingenye yezinto ezithakazelisayo kakhulu endaweni yabantwana.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Ungabona imibhoshongo enxa-ntathu ebumnyameni futhi ungawabona lapho kuthulile ngaphambi kokuqala kombukiso.
hypothesis: Ungabona iPyramids emnyama futhi ungabona kuzo ngaphambi kokuba iqala.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Ngokuvamile uhlala uzwa umsindo wezivakashi nabathengisi. Udaba lomsindo nokukhanya lufana nencwadi yezindaba.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile uva uwaye uvele emazweni wabathengi. Indaba yomsindo nomlilo yifana incwadi yendaba.

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: ISphinx ibekwe njengesigcawu nomlandisi wodaba olude.
hypothesis: ISifiniksi isethwe njengesithombe esikhulu nesithombe esingumqondisi weendaba ezinde.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Izigcawu zikhonjiswa kumaphiramidi kanti amaphiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.
hypothesis: Imiboniso ibonakaliswe kwi-pyramids kanye ne-pyramids ehlukene zikhanyiswe.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Iziqhingi zaseShetland eseNyakatho, ezitholwe ngo-1819, zinezizwe eziningi ezithi ziwela kuzo futhi zinezikhungo eziningi, eziyishumi nesishiyagalolunye ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.
hypothesis: Imizana yaseNingizimu Shetland, eyatholakala ngo-1819, yafakwa yizizwe eziningi futhi inezindawo eziyisithupha eziqhubekayo ngo-2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: I-archipelago isendaweni eqhele ngamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Enkulu kuwo i-King George enendawo e-Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: U-archipelago lise-120 km enyakatho ye-Peninsula. INkosi George Island enkulu kunazo zonke ne- settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Okunye kuhlanganisa isiqhingi seLivingston, kanye neDeception lapho imbobo enkulu egcwele udaka lwentabamlilo esaphuquka umlilo yenza itheku elimangalisayo elingokwemvelo.
hypothesis: Abanye zihlanganisa Livingston Island, futhi Deception lapho i-caldera elivuthayo yezwe esetshenziswa isikhathi eside inikeza indawo yezulu emangalisayo.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: IZwe lase-Ellsworth liyindawo eseningizimu neNhlonhlo, likhawuliswe uLwandle iBellingshausen.
hypothesis: U-Ellsworth Land yindawo eseningizimu yePeninsula, elawulwa yiBellingshausen Sea.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Izintaba zeNhlonhlo zihlangana enkangaleni, bese zihlangana futhi ukwakha uchungechunge lweziNtaba sase-Ellsworth, ezinqunywa phakathi yiGilesiya yase-Minnesota.
hypothesis: Amagquma asePeninsula apha ahlanganisana neplateau, bese aphuma futhi ayeza kuzakhela umkhawulo we360 km weEllsworth Mountains, ehlukaniswe ngeMinnesota Glacier.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Ingxenye engasenyakatho noma iSentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kunazo zonke zase-Antarctica, iVinson Massif, ephakeme yaba ngu-4892 m iMount Vinson.
hypothesis: Inxalenye yaseNyakatho noma iSentinel Range iqukethe i-Antarctica's ephakeme kakhulu amagquma, i-Vinson Massif, ephakeme kakhulu kwi-4892 m Mount Vinson.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yefoni esebenzayo, ifoni yesiphuphutheki kungaba yiyo kuphela into ongayisebenzisa.
hypothesis: Emizaneni esikude, ngaphandle kwesimo sezindawo zeselula, ifoni yeselula ingaba yisinyathelo sakho esisodwa.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Ifoni ye-satellite ngokuvamile ayithatheli ifoni ephathwayo indawo, njengoba kudingeka ube ngaphandle uqondene nesiphuphutheki ukuze ushaye ucingo.
hypothesis: Ucingo lwe-satellite aluyinto oluhlobene nezingcingo zomakhalekhukhwini, njengoba kudinga ukuba uhlale phandle nendawo ecacileyo yomhlaba ukuze wenze ucingo.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Isevisi isetshenziswa kaningi yimikhumbi, kubandakanya umsebenzi wobungcweti, kanye nohambo olunezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Inkampani yezingcingo yangakini kumelwe ikwazi ukukunikeza imininingwane engeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulolu hlelo.
hypothesis: Umnikezeli wakho wenkonzo yefoni yesithili kufanele akunikeze ulwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuxhumana nale sevisi.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Indlela ethandwayo ekhulayo yalabo abahlela ukuthatha unyaka wokuphumula ekufundeni ukuthatha uhambo nokufunda.
hypothesis: Ukukhula kakhulu okukhethwa kukhona kulabo abahlela unyaka wokuhlukana, yize ukuhamba nokufunda.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu abaqeda isikole, okubavumela ukuthi bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kwenyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuyekethisa imfundo yabo.
hypothesis: Lezi zinto ziyaziwa kakhulu phakathi kwabafundi abasebukhosini, okuvumela ukuba bathathe unyaka phambi kweyunivesithi, ngaphandle kokuphazamisa imfundo yabo.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa esifundweni sonyaka wokuphumula ngemva kwesikole kwelinye izwe empeleni kuthuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme emuva ezweni lakini.
hypothesis: In amaningi izimo, ukubhalisa kwesikole unyaka-gap phesheya kungase kuthuthukise amathuba akho okuthi uhambele emfundo ephakeme emazweni wakho.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Ngokujwayelekile kuzoba nemali yokukhokhela izifundo yokubhalisa kulezi zinhelo zemfundo.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile kuzodingeka khona imali yokufunda ukuze ubhalise kulezi zinhlelo zokufunda.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: IFinland indawo ekahle yokuhamba ngesikebhe. "I-Lake of a thousand lakes" ineziqhingi eziyizinkulungwane futhi, emachibini kanye nasemaqoqweni eziqhingi ezingasogwini.
hypothesis: IFinland iyindawo enkulu yokubhukuda. ILand of a thousand lakes inezindawo eziningi zeziqhingi, kuzo zonke izindawo zeziqhingi kanye neziqhingi zeziqhingi.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Edlanzaneni leziqhingi nasemachibini awudingi isikebhe.
hypothesis: Emazweni aseziqithi neziqithi kanye neziqithi, awudingi ngempela ukuhamba ngeyathi.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Yize iziqhingi ezingasogwini kanye namachibi amakhulu kunawo wonke emakhulu ngokwanele ukuthwala noma imuphi umkhumbi kanokusho, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak inikeza okwenzekayo okuhlukile.
hypothesis: Ngisho noma i-coastal archipelagos ne-lakes enkulu kakhulu zinamandla okwanele yonke i-yacht, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak zinikeza umuzwa ohlukile.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Ukuhamba ngezikebhe indlela yokuzilibazisa yezwe eFinland, ngesikebhe kubantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngesikebhe kuyinto yezemidlalo yaseFinland, ne isikebhe kuba wonke amasonto ayisikhombisa noma amane.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Lokhu kufana ne-Norway, i-Sweden kanye neNyuzilandi, kodwa ngaphandle kwalokho kuhlukile ngempela (isib. E-Netherlands isibalo okukodwa kuya kwezingamashumi amane).
hypothesis: Lo muntu uqinile ngoNorway, Sweden neNew Zealand, kodwa lapha kuyahlukahluka kakhulu (isib. eNetherlands inani liyi-1 kuya ku-40).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Iningi lweMikhumbi yokuVakasha yase-Baltic ehlukile ihlanganisa ukuhlala isikhathi eside e-St. Petersburg, e-Russia.
hypothesis: Iningi lezindiza ze-Baltic ezihlukile ziqukethe ukuphila okude eSt. Petersburg, eRussia.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elingokomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ezigcwele ube ubuyela futhi ulala emkhumbini ebusuku.
hypothesis: Lo kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elidala imihla emibili egcwele, futhi uyeke futhi uhlale esikepeni ebusuku.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Uma uya ogwini kuphela usebenzisa uhambo lomkhumbi olufishane angeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).
hypothesis: Uma uya kuphela emhlabeni usebenzisa i-excursions yezikhumulo zezindiza awudingi i-visa ehlukile (njengamanje).

reference: Eminye imikhumbi yokuvakasha iveza i-Berlin, eseJalimane ezincwajaneni zayo. Njengoba ubona ebalazweni ngenhla i-Berlin ikude kakhulu nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe enanini lomkhumbi wokuvakasha.
hypothesis: Abanye amakhasi afaka iBerlin, eJalimane emibhalweni. source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba isenzakalo esithusayo kubantu beminyaka yonke nezizinda zonke, ikakhulukazi uma bengakahambi ngendiza ngaphambili noma uma behlangabezane nesenzakalo esishaqisayo.
hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngezindiza kungaba yinto enezinto zonke izizukulwane nabantu abahlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma bebehlupheke ngaphambi noma baphathe isimo esibi.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Akuyona into yokuba namahloni ngayo: ayihlukile ezintweni ezisatshwa abantu ngabanye abaningi nalezo abangazithandi.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Kwabanye abantu, ukuzwisisa okuthile kokuthi indiza isebenza kanjani nokuthi kwenzekani phakathi nokundiza kungabasiza ukuthi banqobe ukwesaba okusekelwe ezintweni ezingaziwa noma ukungaphathi izintambo.
hypothesis: Kubathile, ukuqonda into ethile mayelana nendlela izindiza zisebenza kanye nenzuzo eyenzekayo ngexesha lokuhamba kungasiza ekusombululeni ukwesaba okusekelwe engaziwayo okanye engabonakaliyo.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Izinkampani ezithutha impahla zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuthumela impahla ngokushehsa. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibalulekile ngamaphepha ebhizinisi, impahla ethengwayo ukuze idayiswe noma enye impahla edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okusheshayo.
hypothesis: Amakhasimende e-courier ahlinzekwa ngemali enkulu ukuhambisa izinto ngokushesha. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi siyadingeka kakhulu ngezincwadi zebhizinisi, izimpahla noma izingxenye ezisele zokulungisa ukukhathazeka okusheshayo.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkudlwana zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane bekunezinkinga.
hypothesis: Eminye imizila, izinkampani ezinkulu zinezindiza zazo, kepha eminye imizila nezinkampani ezincane kwadingeka inkinga.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Uma bebathumele zonke izinto ngebhanoyi, kwezinye izindlela bekuzothatha izinsuku ukwehlisa imithwalo nokudlula kwabahlola amaphepha.
hypothesis: Uma beqesha izinto ngezindiza, emigwaqeni ethile kungathatha izinsuku ukuthi udlule unloading kanye nemiyalo yezilwane.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Indlela elula yokuyingenisa ngokushesha ukuthi uyithumele njengomthwalo ohloliwe. Imithetho yezinkampani zezindiza angeke ibavumele ukuthumela umthwalo ngaphandle komgibeli, okuyilapho ungena khona.
hypothesis: Indlela kuphela ukuthi uthathe ngayo ngokushesha kwakuyothumela njengezimpahla zokulayisha. Imithetho yezindiza ngeke ivumele zimpahla ngaphandle umgibeli, lapho uya khona.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Indlela esobala yokugibela egumbini lendiza elibizayo noma labebhizinisi ukukhipha imali eningi yalelo lungelo (noma, okugcono, wenze inkampani yakho ikwenzele lokho).
hypothesis: Indlela ecacileyo yokuhamba kwiklasi yokuqala okanye ibhizinisi kukudlulisela imali eninzi yezinto eziphambili (okanye, okungcono, uthole inkampani yakho ukuyenza kuwe).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Noma kunjalo, lokhu akufiki kalula: njengomthetho obekiwe, ungalindela ukukhokha izikhathi eziphindwe kane kunenani elivamile lomnotho webhizinisi, kanye nezikhathi eziyishumi nanye ezingeni lokuqala!
hypothesis: Kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi kubiza okuningi: njengomthetho wokubhula, ungathanda ukukhokhela kufika ku-amanani amane wendiza yezokuvakasha yendabuko, kanye nekhilikithi yokuqala eyodwa!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Ngokuvamile, akusizi ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo ezihlalweni zabebhizinisi noma ezinethezekile ohabweni lwendiza oluqondile olusuka ku-A luye ku-B.
hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, akukho lutho olufanele ukubheka izaphulelo zezindiza eziqondile zomsebenzi noma zezindiza zokuqala ezivela ku-A kuya ku-B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Izinkampani zezindiza zazi kahle ukuthi kuneqembu elithile eliyisisekelo labagibeli bezindiza abazimisele ukukhokha ama-dollar aphezulu ukuze bathole ilungelo lofika endaweni ethile ngokushesha futhi ngokunethezeka, futhi babakhokhisa ngokufanele.
hypothesis: Amakheshi azi kahle ukuthi kukhona iqembu elithile labahambi abazokhokhela imali enkulu ukuze bafinyelele kwindawo ngokushesha nangokuphumula, futhi bawabize ngokufanele.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChișinău. Ulimi lwendawo isiRomaniya, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kabanzi.
hypothesis: Umbuso we Moldova usesikhulunyana se Chişinău. Ulwimi lwasekhaya luyi Romanian, kepha isiRussia siyasetshenziswa kabanzi.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.

source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.

source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.

source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.

source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.

reference: Abasebenzi kumele kaningi bathole imvume yabaphathi babo nganoma yiziphi izinqumo ebazenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi balalele imiyalo yabaphathi babo ngale kokuthini.
hypothesis: Abasebenzi badinga ukuthola imvume yabaphathi babo nganoma yiziphi izinqumo abazenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuba balalele imiyalo yabaphathi babo ngaphandle kwesibindi.
